title: providerPickerReading
responsibility: Reads model picker responses: snapshots, queued sessions, selection labels and failure text.

inputs.name: readSessions.data
inputs.description: A response to a request for queued sessions, or null.

inputs.name: selectionLabel.target
inputs.description: The provider and model of a queued switch.

inputs.name: failureText.fallback
inputs.description: The text to use when the thrown value is not an Error.

outputs.name: isSnapshot
outputs.description: True when the response names the default provider and so is a picker snapshot.

outputs.name: readSessions
outputs.description: The queued sessions, or null when the response holds no list.

outputs.name: selectionLabel
outputs.description: The catalog label of the model, or the model id when the catalog does not list it.

outputs.name: failureText
outputs.description: The error message, or the fallback.
